sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Type / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: Which feature in an electronic spreadsheet allows you to display only the rows that meet certain specific numerical criteria?
True or False: In digital presentation software, a Master Slide is used to apply a consistent background layout and font style across all slides simultaneously.
What keyboard symbol is placed before the column letter and row number to create an absolute cell reference in a spreadsheet formula?
Which of the following practices is the most effective method to mitigate a phishing attack?
options: A) Clicking embedded links in urgent emails immediately
B) Verifying the sender's actual email address and domain
C) Disabling the computer's built-in firewall
D) Providing account passwords over text messages
questions.answer: B) Verifying the sender's actual email address and domain

questions.question_text: In presentation software, what is the specific term for the dynamic visual effects applied to individual text boxes or images when they appear on screen?
Which built-in spreadsheet function is specifically used to find the highest numerical value in a selected range of data cells?
True or False: Malware is a generic cyber security term used to describe malicious software designed to disrupt, damage, or gain unauthorized access to a computer system.
If you enter the formula '=A1*B1' in cell C1 and copy it downward to cell C2, what will the formula become in C2 assuming relative referencing?
What is the primary purpose of enabling a firewall in a local computer network?
options: A) To automatically backup corrupted system files
B) To monitor and filter incoming and outgoing network traffic
C) To format old data drives securely
D) To boost internet download speeds
questions.answer: B) To monitor and filter incoming and outgoing network traffic

questions.question_text: When creating a bar chart in a spreadsheet program, what represents the horizontal baseline against which the data points are plotted?
Differentiate between a slide transition and a custom animation in digital presentation software. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A transition is the visual effect that occurs when moving between entire slides, whereas custom animation controls how individual objects like text or images enter the slide.

questions.question_text: Define the term 'phishing' in the context of cyber safety and network security. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Phishing is a cyber attack where criminals impersonate legitimate organizations via email or messages to trick users into revealing sensitive information like passwords or bank details.

questions.question_text: What is the specific function of utilizing the 'Master Slide' view in presentation software? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The Master Slide controls the default layout, typography, background, and formatting for a presentation, ensuring a uniform visual design is automatically applied across all slides.

questions.question_text: Explain how conditional formatting is practically utilized within an electronic spreadsheet application. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Conditional formatting automatically changes the visual appearance of cells, such as background color or font style, based on whether the data meets specific user-defined rules.

questions.question_text: Why is it critical to keep antivirus software definitions regularly updated on a workstation? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Regular updates provide the antivirus software with the latest virus definitions and security patches, enabling it to accurately detect and protect against new and emerging cyber threats.

questions.question_text: A student wants to calculate the total marks of 5 subjects located in cells C2 to G2. Write the formula and explain how to replicate it for 40 students using the fill handle. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Enter =SUM(C2:G2) in cell H2 to calculate the total. Click the small square at the bottom-right corner of H2 and drag it down to row 41; the relative referencing automatically adjusts the formula for each student.

questions.question_text: Describe a scenario where applying a data filter in a spreadsheet would be more beneficial than just sorting the entire dataset alphabetically. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Filtering is highly beneficial when analyzing a massive school database to view only students who failed a specific math exam. While sorting just rearranges everyone, filtering temporarily hides passing students, isolating exactly the target group needed.

questions.question_text: Read the following case context: A school administrator is creating an annual day presentation. They want the school logo to appear in the exact same corner on all 50 slides and need text bullet points to appear one by one upon clicking. Detail the presentation tools required. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The administrator should insert the school logo into the Slide Master view; this automatically places it in the exact same position on all fifty slides without manual copying. Next, they must apply custom animation to the text boxes, setting the trigger effect to 'On Click' for individual bullet points.

questions.question_text: Read the following case context: Rahul frequently downloads free software from unverified websites and uses the same simple password 'password123' for all his online accounts. Analyze the potential cyber threats he faces and suggest three concrete defensive strategies. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Rahul faces critical risks of malware infections from unverified software downloads and severe identity compromise through credential stuffing attacks due to his weak, reused password. To secure his digital footprint, he must download files only from official sources, create strong, unique alphanumeric passwords for every platform, and activate two-factor authentication.
